title: Fix CI: reset $LASTEXITCODE after simulated deps.ps1 failure test
paragraphs: test-install.ps1 mocks a failed `pip install` to verify deps.ps1 stops on error, which deliberately leaves $global:LASTEXITCODE at 1. Nothing reset it afterward, so it lingered to the end of the script. GitHub Actions runs this script by dot-sourcing it (`pwsh -Command ". 'tests/test-install.ps1'"`), and a dot-sourced script's trailing non-zero $LASTEXITCODE becomes the step's own exit code - so the step failed with no error message even though every assertion, including "PowerShell installer checks passed.", had already succeeded.
